name: Ambiente Sedona
lede: Sedona’s desert nights turn cold from fall to spring. At Ambiente, freestanding Eclipse heaters arch over the communal lounges and fire pits, while Tungsten Electric warms each guest deck and the places where staff stand outside.
data: Landscape hotel – communal lounges, guest decks
Eclipse Smart-Heat® Freestanding · Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric

hero.caption: Eclipse Freestanding over the sofas and fire pits at dusk. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

Eclipse heaters over the communal lounge. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Ambiente sits among Sedona’s red rocks, with modern architecture that balances private guest quarters with communal spaces: outdoor couches, linear fire pits and a pool.
Temperatures can drop sharply from fall to spring. The hotel needed heaters powerful enough for cold desert conditions that also suited its modern design.

Bromic’s design team drafted heat plans for both models and coordinated with Ambiente’s electrician before the grand opening. Eclipse Freestanding reaches over the couches and fire pits; Tungsten Electric covers the private patio decks and staff work areas.
